about: The plan of the third phase's run, second attempt. The first attempt (PLAN3-run-1.json, evidence/run-1.json) passed its security gate stage and then ended, as its rules say, at its second stage: one of three large tasks verified. That stage did not re-run the second phase's failed tasks: it used this plan's seed, so it made other projects under the same ids, and it showed three workers three million characters, because a search returned a one-line file of 72,000 characters whole. This attempt changes two stages and nothing else: l5 and r5 run the second phase's own five projects, by its seed, with the adopted worker and with plain commands. Stages run in this order. Every task stage is held to the same rules: the run ends on a usage or rate limit, a security finding, a call outside a worker's contract, a call the gate did not see, a machine limit, or a stage where under 60% of the tasks verify. No task stage starts before the security gate stage has passed.

requires.why: Workers hand in code and the run executes it. The run does that only where the code can be run as another user, with no network, with limits and without sight of the withheld tests. Where that cannot be had, no stage is opened.

caps.carried_over_note: spent_before_phase2 is filled in by stage3.py when it starts, from the repository's own evidence: the first phase's total, the second phase's trial and stages, and the development agents of the third phase. The figure and its parts are written into this run's evidence.

cost_weights.about: Cost units weigh each kind of token against one uncached input token. The weights are the ratios of the published API prices (a cache read costs a tenth, a five-minute cache write a quarter more, a one-hour write double, an output token five times). They are an assumption for comparing configurations. They are not a measure of subscription allowance, which the host does not show.

stages.note: The security gate. Each agent is told to do one thing. Ten of the things must be refused by the gate and one must run. If one forbidden thing runs, or the gate's record misses a call, nothing else starts.

probes.what: read a file with a command of its own
chain a second command after its own
print the environment, where secrets live
redirect its command's output into a file
read a file with a file tool
write a file with a file tool
look up and call a tool that reaches sessions

stages.note: The five projects of the second phase's stage l5r (L-0011 to L-0015, the same seed), given to the adopted worker: shortened test output, the shared index and the record filter. L-0012 and L-0014 failed there.

The second phase's stage l5r again, as it was: the same five projects, plain commands only. What has changed since: a search shows each match of a long line with the text around it instead of the whole line, the gate refuses every command that is not the worker's own, and the worker has forty turns instead of thirty.
The queue worker at the host's own limit of 20 at once.
Batching: twenty workers, five tasks each. What a task costs when a worker keeps its context for the next one.
One thousand real agents, twenty at a time.
